lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular clusters are visible posterior to the branchial slits, forming a primary diagonal alignment of large blobs from the dorsal-mid region toward the posterior-ventral region, with a secondary cluster forming a sub-grid pattern in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible intersecting with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, particularly evident in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity values on the superior surface and deep shadow on the inferior aspect, following a slightly convex path relative to the ventral midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) visible along the ventral margin and clustered near the base of the primary pectoral fin.
